text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Cold... and quiet... Being alone... feels 
so comforting...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A trip to the lake... you say...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! A pal of mine recommended 
it a while back. We've got the day off 
next, so wanna go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, marvelous idea! Being near the water 
should allow for novel experiments unique 
to an aquatic environment! We must go! 
Without question, we are going!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............Very well... I don't mind....

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time to experiment! Where would 
be best... somewhere stable enough to set 
up the apparatus—aha.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, hell yeah! Fishing, canoeing, jet 
skiing! I'm gonna tear it up and play till 
I drop!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, I'm getting hungry first. I'll go 
ask around for a good place to eat!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief... completely 
unrestrained...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Well, no helping it... in that case, I 
will...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...So quiet... and peaceful... The 
water's surface... sparkles so brightly—)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(I'm glad I came... to be able to see... 
something so beautiful... And 
yet............)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Cafeee! Don't wander off on your 
own! Let's get this barbecue started 
together!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! Where have you gone when our 
experiment is just about to begin? 
Honestly, it's quite troublesome if you 
don't show yourself promptly!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(Those voices... that always call out for 
me...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Without hearing those voices... it just 
wouldn't be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had left something behind during daytime 
training. Thinking about how this had 
happened once before, I visited the pool 
at night, where—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............Did you forget something... 
again...?
choice_data_list: Are you by yourself again today...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No... today, there are others...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Sorry to keep you waiting! Let us 
begin at once, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Cafe, I'm here! We don't have all 
night, so let's lock in and focus!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Today... the three of us... made plans to 
train together...
choice_data_list:
Looks like you're having more fun than 
before!

You look like you're enjoying yourself 
more than before!

Since I'm here, mind if I watch your 
training?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Today... the three of us... made plans to 
train together...
choice_data_list:
Looks like you're having more fun than 
before!

You look like you're enjoying yourself 
more than before!

Since I'm here, mind if I watch your 
training?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............Does it... seem that way to 
you...?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, everyone looks like they're having a 
blast!

Yeah, everyone looks like they're having 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I see... If so... I'm glad, then...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Cafe! Hurry up and get over hereee!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who invited us, after 
all. Naturally, you will let me collect 
data to my heart's content today, won't 
you!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............Truly, how rowdy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Well then... I shall be going...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Manhattan Cafe was difficult to 
read, a distinct smile could clearly be 
seen upon her profile tonight—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............Um... you really shouldn't... 
If you get involved with those two—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Could it be that you wish to partake 
in the experiment as well? Wonderful, 
wonderful, you are most welcome!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hold up though, we ain't got room for 
half-steppers! You better be ready for 
this, got it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...See... what did I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her warning came just a moment too late. 
And so, for quite a while, I ended up 
getting thoroughly dragged around—
